title: Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 - Servio Consulting, LLC - Chief Systems and Services Officer
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Agreement 2020-2021 between the District and Servio Consulting, LLC, Frankfort, IL, for the latter to reprogram COVID Daily Assessment survey to add conditional logic between questions to allow subsequent questions to be dependent on responses to previous question(s) across web, text and voice input methods, for the period of September 01, 2020 through June 30, 2021, in the additional amount of $2,900.00, increasing the Agreement not to exceed amount from $35,000.00 to $37,900.00. group: Measure N Commission - January 14, 2021 David Kakishiba, Chairperson
title: Measure N Commission - 2019-2020 Carryover Funds - Named District and Charter Schools
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2021-0186 - Measure N - College and Career Readiness Commission - Carryover 2019- 2020 Measure N Fund Balance, for Named District and Charter Schools, in the cumulative amount of $1,831,416.23.
headline: Carries over $1,831,416.23 in unspent 2019-2020 Measure N funds for named district and charter schools
summary: The Board adopts a resolution letting district and charter schools carry unspent 2019-2020 Measure N (college and career readiness) funds into the next year. The cumulative amount is $1,831,416.23. The text does not list the individual schools or how each will use its share.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Measure G1 - District Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission - Jill Habig, Chairperson
title: Measure G1 Commission - 2019-2020 Carryover Funds - Named District Middle Schools
official_text: Adoption by Board of Education of Resolution No. 2021-0187 -  Measure G1 - District-wide Teacher Retention and Middle School Improvement Act Oversight Commission Recommendation Permitting Carry-over of 2019-2020 School Year Unexpended Measure G1 Funds and Approving Plans Therefor for Named District Middle School, in the cumulative amount of $20,123.97.
headline: Carries over $20,123.97 in unspent 2019-2020 Measure G1 funds for named district middle schools
summary: The Board adopts a resolution, recommended by the Measure G1 oversight commission, letting named district middle schools carry unspent 2019-2020 Measure G1 (teacher retention and middle school improvement) funds into the next year and approving their plans for the money. The cumulative amount is $20,123.97. The text does not list the individual schools.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Non Competitively Bid - Star Elevator - Fremont High School New Construction Project - Division of Facilities Planning Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Non Competitively Bid - on behalf of the District to Star Elevator, (“Contractor”),  San Carlos, CA, for the latter to provide labor and material to modify the fire service circuitry on the passenger elevator, for the Fremont High School New Construction Project, in the amount of $39,435.00, which includes a contingency of $2,030.33, as the selected contractor, and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Agreement for same with said contractor,  with work scheduled to commence on February 11, 2021, and scheduled to last until June 30, 2021, pursuant to the Agreement.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires Star Elevator for $39,435 to modify fire circuitry on Fremont High's new elevator, without bidding
summary: The district is hiring Star Elevator of San Carlos to modify the fire service circuitry on the passenger elevator for the Fremont High School new construction project. The price is $39,435, which includes a $2,030.33 contingency, and it was not competitively bid. Work is scheduled to run from February 11, 2021 to June 30, 2021, paid from Measure J bond funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
